description: This file defines a Smarty plugin for the modifier 'from_charset', which converts character encoding from a specified charset to the internal charset used by Smarty. It contains the implementation of the function 'smarty_modifiercompiler_from_charset' that handles the encoding conversion logic.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_from_charset
methods.description: Converts the character encoding of a string from a specified charset to Smarty's internal charset, generating the appropriate PHP code for the Smarty template engine.
